process_copy.heading: Mint the ebook NFT
process_copy.body: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_copy.heading: Earn Through Referrals
process_copy.body: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD with no limit. If no code is provided, the $5 and prize ticket are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_copy.heading: Build Up Tickets
process_copy.body: Every completed referral awards one on-chain ticket for the active $500 drawing. More referrals mean more tickets and greater chances to win.

process_copy.heading: Enter the Prize Draw
process_copy.body: One eligible Small Block ticket holder is selected from each 100-sales block to receive $500, including holders of referral-earned tickets and recipients of randomly allocated no-referral tickets. Chainlink VRF provides provably fair randomness.

process_copy.heading: Receive Your Rewards
process_copy.body: Commissions and $500 prize wins are delivered automatically to the winner's wallet, with prize results and notifications available through the Winners page, dashboard, and email when available.

decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already requires displayed commission totals to include randomly issued commissions and reconcile to primary mints while excluding secondary sales.
Excluding secondary sales from commission and ticket issuance does not change royalty enforcement, the royalty amount, or the use of royalty proceeds.
The existing same-message MODIFY already confirms one randomly allocated ticket per no-referral primary mint; display registration is separately represented by ticket accounting.
Expanding ticket eligibility does not alter automatic wallet payout, winner announcements, or notification channels.
The source changes ticket and commission accounting but does not change the 100-sales draw interval or the countdown source.
